interactionRules.sectionNavigation: Each Work2U section opens its full list; tapping a record opens a detailed view.
interactionRules.ticketSituationSimulator: The simulator creates a numbered ticket, workflow run, HelpBuddy checklist, optional asset and knowledge links, and audit events in one permission-checked database operation. It requires an authenticated profile and tickets.manage plus workflows.run permissions.
interactionRules.returnNavigation: Record detail provides a back action to return to the originating list.
interactionRules.sla: Live SLA countdowns must be calculated from actual policy and timestamps when backend data is connected.
interactionRules.permissions: Record fields and actions must respect role and tenant authorization.
interactionRules.quickPicks: Right rail shortcuts are user-customizable and may grow and scroll independently.
interactionRules.marketplace: Marketplace navigation is driven by this manifest. Catalog and price data come from Supabase. Checkout, subscriptions, and provisioning must remain unavailable until their server-side workflows and payment provider are configured.
interactionRules.helpBuddy: Help Buddy remains available as a persistent companion while users work in the center workspace. Its character presentation is separate from Character Studio customization. Messaging remains context-aware across Help Buddy tabs. Share to Workspace prepares a permission-checked collaboration/investigation package; never mutate the original ticket or audit history.

helpBuddy.description: Persistent, context-aware work companion. Help Buddy is an original character/workflow concept, not an AI model.

characterLayer.placement: visible directly below the top-layer tools and above the active conversation/work content
characterLayer.studio: Help Buddy Character Studio only; not a generic AI model studio

persistentMessaging.scope: available while the user works in the Command Center
persistentMessaging.context: retain current ticket, workflow, and record context while switching Help Buddy tools
persistentMessaging.currentPreviewBoundary: browser-local demo messaging; live service and cross-session persistence are not connected

shareToWorkspace.purpose: share selected ticket, workflow, checklist, evidence, communications, approvals, and audit records for collaboration or investigation
shareToWorkspace.integrity: original source records and audit events remain immutable; recipient activity is separately attributed
requirements: preview exact records and sensitive fields
check sender authority and recipient access
record who shared what, with whom, when, and why

hamburgerEntry.label: Modify My Help Buddy
hamburgerEntry.placement: immediately below HelpBuddy in Service Operations
hamburgerEntry.saveBehavior: persist personal character preferences locally in preview and reflect the selected character in the right-side persistent Help Buddy panel

previewAcceptanceCriteria: Open hamburger while Command Center dashboard is visible.
Select Modify My Help Buddy immediately beneath HelpBuddy.
Dedicated customization pop-out opens without replacing the dashboard.
Change character name, presentation, tone, outfit, voice style, and expression.
Close hamburger and verify the same selected character is reflected in the right-side Help Buddy panel.
Refresh preview and verify local character preference persists.
